# Establishment log — popol-vuh-011 (image 0038 last-but-one line, 0039, 0040 to line 15)

Read 2026-11-25 from source/pages/i0038 (last-but-one line, after `… quia molah chi tihobal.`), all of i0039 and
i0040 lines 1–15, in strips of about six lines at 0.9×, with 1.5–2× crops of every doubtful word, checked word by
word against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines 22495–22520, 22582–22640, 22693–22710).
Start: `Are v nabe ri Queꜫuma Ha …` (0038, MS `arevnabe ri`, continuing on 0039 `queꜫuma ha vtuquel queꜫum`).
End: `… Va cute xchi ca biyh roponic.` (0040 l.15). popol-vuh-012 begins at 0040 l.16 with Ximénez's indented
heading `Vae chi cate vꜩihoxic hun capoh, vmeal hun ahau, Cuchumaquic vbi` (Brasseur's CHAPITRE TROISIÈME,
Xquic). The part is short (about 1.4 pages, not the three images parts.json planned) because the manuscript's own
heading falls there; 012 should run from 0040 l.16.

Content: the remaining houses of trial (Dark House, Xuxulim Ha the house of cold, the Jaguar House, the Bat House,
Chaim Ha the house of blades); the fathers are not put through them; before Huncame and Vvcub Came they have
finished the torch and cigar; they are sacrificed and buried at Pucbal Chah; Hunhunahpu's head set in the tree
by the road, which at once bears fruit, the calabash (zima); Xibalba forbids anyone to go near it; a maiden hears.

## Folios
Counting as 004–010 did (0038 = 14v): 0039 = 15r, 0040 = 15v → `fols. 14v–15v`. The crop of 0040 carries 15 at the
top left (the folio doubt in QUESTIONS.md, 2026-11-24, again); the earlier count is kept.

## Letter rule used (002–010's rules, unchanged)
- g-shaped → ꜭ: `ꜭo` ×4 (B. qo), `ruꜭ` ×2 (B. ruq), `vꜭoheic` (B. u qoheic); gh → ꜭh: `xvꜭhax`, `xꜭha` ×2,
  `chuꜭhaxic`, `xeꜭha` ×2.
- q-shaped `qux` → `ꜭux` (009's rule): `chi qui ꜭux` (0040 l.3).
- tresillo → ꜫ: `Queꜫuma Ha`, `queꜫum` (both ʒ-like, as 010), `iꜫih` (0039; MS like `iqeih`, B. y gih),
  `chaꜫol` (see below).
- tz ligature (the looped form) → ꜩ: `ꜩaꜩ`, `ꜩapim`, `ꜩapin`, `Ꜩoꜩi Ha`, `ꜩoꜩ` ×2, `ꜩiꜩotic`, `ꜩitilahic`,
  `ꜩininic`, `Vꜩ`, `vꜩihoxic`.
- z (plain ʒ, no loop) kept as z: `zac`, `nu zic`, `xquiz`, `quizo`, `zachic`, `puzic`/`puz`, `huzu`, and
  **`zima` ×3** (0039 l.41, 0040 l.1, l.12; B. tzima). Compared at 2× with the looped ligature of `Ꜩoꜩi` on the
  same page: the letter of `zima` has no loop. Printed as written; the word is presumably tz'ima' 'calabash'
  (the drafter's mt and note decide).
- plain c kept where Brasseur has g, q or k: `cac caracoh` (B. zak; MS clearly c, not the ʒ of `zac xuruxuh` the
  line before — doubtful whether 'red' or a slip for zac 'white'), `Xcat vholom` (B. x-gat), `vchac` (B. u chag),
  `Ma co` ×2 (B. ma qo), `xqui quil quib` (B. x-qui gil), `calah` ×2, `ruc vvach che` (0040 l.12; B. ruq; the
  letter is plain c where `ruꜭ` on 0040 l.1 has the g), `hun capoh` (B. gapoh), `xca quizo` (B. ka qizo),
  `xchi ca biyh` (B. ka biyh), `Xquec` (see below).

## Doubtful readings and decisions against Brasseur
- 0039 l.4 `cac caracoh` — see above.
- 0039 l.7 `balam ꜭo chupan` (MS `chu|pan`, n; B. chupam).
- 0039 l.7 `que quichouic` (MS u; B. quichouic).
- 0039 l.8 `que chi qui tit`: MS `chiquiht` — in this hand t and h are both tall and hard to tell apart (compare
  `vtihobal`, written like `vhhobal`); read `qui tit` with Brasseur. Doubtful.
- 0039 l.11 `que ꜩiꜩotic, que ꜩitilahic` (B. tzitzotic, tzitilahic): MS `ꜩiꜩohic`, `ꜩih'lahic`; the same t/h
  doubt, decided with Brasseur.
- 0039 l.12 `e ꜩapin` with n, where l.9 has `ꜩapim` with m; both as written.
- 0039 l.13 `Roo chicut` (B. OCR Коо = Roo): the first letter is Ximénez's r, which can look like v.
- 0039 l.14 `chaꜫol` (B. chakol): a q-shaped letter with an ink blot on the next letter; taken as the tresillo
  (q-shaped, no u following). Doubtful; the blot may hide another letter.
- 0039 l.15 `zac leloh re chi cha` (MS `ʒaclelohre`; B. zaklelohre undivided): divided by us; doubtful.
- 0039 l.16 `Que nabec` (B. Qui nabec): MS `que` with a blot over the e.
- 0039 l.19 a word struck through by Ximénez between `Hunahpu` and `chupam` (it looks like `xe`); not printed.
- 0039 l.20 `xa vbixic apon oc vtihobal ha` (B. `xa u bixic apon-oc a bi tihobal ha`).
- 0039 l.24 `xhe yaoc` (MS `xheyaoc`; B. ya-oc).
- 0039 l.25 **`Xquec xvꜭhax cut`**: MS `xquec xvghax / cut.`, read at 2×; the first word is clear in its letters
  but not understood (Brasseur's OCR has `€ x-euchax cut`, i.e. he does not print it as a word). Printed as written;
  the drafter should say it is unclear.
- 0039 l.27 `xquiz iꜫih` (B. x-qiz y gih).
- 0039 l.28 `xqui zachic, xqui ca cup puch` (B. x-qu'y zachic, x-qu'y ca cup): MS `xquiʒachic`, `xquica cup` —
  no second x where the preceding `Quix camic` has one. Printed as written.
- 0039 l.29 `Varal xchi vevah vi ivach` (MS `xchivevah`; B. `x-ch'yv'euah`): xchi divided as 010 does.
- 0039 l.32 `xe muc vi` before `Xcat` (MS `xemucvi`); Brasseur omits it.
- 0039 l.33 `Xcat vholom` — see above.
- 0039 l.38 `Ta xvachin curi che` (MS `curi che`; joined `curi` as 010).
- 0040 l.2 `ta chul qui caiih` (MS `quicaiih`, no descender for y; B. qui cayih).
- 0040 l.6–7 `Ma co ma chupuvic ri vvach; ma co naipu ma oc apan oc chuxe che` (MS `maco machupuvic`, `maco
  naipu maoc apanoc`).
- 0040 l.12 `ruc vvach che` — see above.
- 0040 l.14 `Va cute` (MS `vacute`; B. va cate).
- Names: `Xuxulim Ha`, `Balami Ha`, `Ꜩoꜩi Ha`, `Chaim Ha` (B. Chayim-ha), `Pucbal Chah` (B. Pucbal-chah) capitalised
  as names; `hun capoh` 'a maiden' lower case (not yet a name).

Nothing set aside; no gap.
